title: Using Kubernetes with AWS Lambda: Scaling Up Your Serverless Applications
summary: A vendor blog post whose concrete part is a walkthrough of creating a Lambda function from an EKS cluster with the AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK) Lambda controller, closely following AWS’s own 2022 tutorial. The benefits section is vague and blurs what Kubernetes and Lambda each do, and the post ends with a pitch for Lumigo’s observability product.
